का.आ. 5322(अ).-रेलवे (संशोधन) अधिनियम, 2008 की धारा 20 ए की उप-धारा (॥) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्ति का 
प्रयोग करते हुए (इसके बाद उक्त अधिनियम के रूप में संदर्भित), केंद्र सरकार, इस बात से संतुष्ट होने के बाद कि सार्वजनिक 
उद्देश्य के लिए, अतिरिक्त भूमि जो रेलवे (संशोधन) अधिनियम, 2008 की धारा 200(4) के तहत अधिसूचना के पहले 
चरण संख्या 206, दिनांक 40 मई, 2022 के अनुरूप एस.ओ.2468(ई), दिनांक 27 अप्रैल, 2022 के दौरान छोड़े गए, 
जिसका संक्षिप्त विवरण नीचे अनुसूची में दिया गया है, ओडिशा राज्य के झारसुगुड़ा जिले में विशेष रेलवे परियोजना के 
रूप में “दोहरी लाइन फ्लाईओवर झारसुगुड़ा यार्ड संशोधन सहित (26 कि.मी.)” के निष्पादन, अनुरक्षण प्रबंधन और 
परिचालन के लिए अपेक्षित है एतद्‌ द्वारा भूमि अधिग्रहण की घोषणा की जाती है। 

उक्त भूमि में रुचि रखनेवाला कोई भी व्यक्ति, शासकीय राजपत्र में अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से 30 


(तीस) दिनों की अवधि के भीतर उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20घ की उपधारा (॥) के तहत उपर्युक्त प्रयोजन के लिए ऐसी 
भूमि के अधिग्रहण और उपयोग पर आपत्ति कर सकता है।

भी बताएगा और सक्षम प्राधिकारी आपत्तिकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रुप से अथवा विधिकर्ता के माध्यम से सुनने का एक अवसर 
देगा और ऐसी सभी आपत्तियों को सुनने और इस तरह की आगे की जांच करने के बाद, यदि कोई हो, जैसा सक्षम 


प्राधिकारी आवश्यक समझे, आदेश द्वारा आपत्तियों को स्वीकार या अस्वीकार कर सकता है।

MINISTRY OF RAILWAYS 
[South Eastern Railway (Construction Organization) ] 
NOTIFICATION 
Kolkata, the llth December 2023 


S.O. 5322(E).—In exercise of Power conferred by sub-section (l) of section 20A of the Railways 
(Amendment) Act,2008 (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the additional land left over during |* phase of notification under section 20A(L) of The Railways 
(Amendment) Act, 2008 vide No.206], dated l0th May, 2022 corresponding to S.0.2l68(E), dated 27th April, 2022, 
the brief description of which is given in the schedule below, is required for execution, maintenance, management and 
operation of “Double line Flyover including JSG yard modification (26 Km.)” as Special Railway Project in the 
district of Jharsuguda in the state of Odisha, hereby declares its intension to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within a period of thirty days from the date of publication of the 
notification in the official Gazette, object, under sub-section () of the section 20D of the said Act to the acquisition 
and use of such land for the aforesaid purpose. 


Every such objection shall be made to the competent authority, Viz. Dy. Chief 
Engineer/Construction/Jharsuguda, South Eastern Railway in his office at near Jharsuguda Railway station, Dist.- 
Jharsuguda (Odisha), Pin-76820] in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and competent authority shall give 
the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such 
objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the competent authority thinks necessary, by order, either 
allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under Sub-Section (2) of section 20D of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans & the other details of the land covered under notification are available and can be inspected 
by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the competent Authority.

सभी पदों के लिए आवश्यक अनुभव अनुसूची | में निर्दिष्ट अनुसार होगा। पद के लिए अपेक्षित अनुभव निर्धारित 
करने की निर्णायक तिथि अभ्यर्थी से आवेदन प्राप्त करने की अंतिम तिथि होगी। 


भर्ती अनुसूची । में निर्धारित अनुसार की जाएगी। जब भी पद सीधी भर्ती द्वारा भरा जाना हो, तो पदों का 
विज्ञापन आरआईपीएएनएस की वेबसाइट और समाचार पत्रों में ऐसे उचित तरीकों से किया जाएगा जो संस्थान 
प्राधिकरण उचित समझे। बड़ी संख्या में आवेदन प्राप्त होने की स्थिति में, निदेशक एक स्क्रीनिंग कमेटी का गठन 
कर सकते हैं, जो अभ्यर्थियों का चयन करेगी। 


सीधी भर्ती के मामले में, पद के लिए नौकरी की आवश्यकता को ध्यान में रखते हुए चयन समिति द्वारा तय किए 
गए विभिन्न मापदंडों के लिए विशिष्ट अंक देकर चयन पारदर्शी होगा। सक्षम प्राधिकारी द्वारा गठित चयन समिति 
सभी पात्र अभ्यर्थियों के साक्षात्कार, जैसा आवश्यक हो, आयोजित करेगी। 


पदधारी के प्रतिनियुक्ति या लंबी बीमारी या अध्ययन अवकाश या अन्य परिस्थितियों में एक वर्ष या उससे अधिक

Short Title and commencement: - 


These rules may be called the Recruitment Rules of Group ‘A’ Non - Faculty Post (Accounts Officer), 
Regional Institute of Paramedical & Nursing Sciences, Aizawl, Mizoram, 2023. 


They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 
The number of posts, classification and level in the Pay Matrix: - 


The number of the said posts, their classification and the level in the Pay Matrix attached thereto shall be as 
specified in Schedule I. The classification of posts as Group A will correspond to similar categories in the 
Pay Level of Central Government. 


Recruitment Norms: - 


The minimum educational qualification for all the posts shall be as specified in Schedule I. The specified 
discipline for educational qualification in related areas of interest of the faculty in respect of RIPANS, 
required for the post concerned, will be as given in Schedule I, before the posts are advertised. Educational 
qualifications of recognized University and regulating Statutory Bodies, as the case may be, will only be 
accepted. In case of any doubt regarding educational qualification, the decision of Appointing Authority will 
be final and binding. 


The experience required for all the posts shall as specified in Schedule I. The crucial date for determining the 
experience required for the post shall be the closing date for receipt of application from candidates. 


Recruitment shall be made by promotion/deputation/direct recruitment as the case may be, as prescribed in 
Schedule I. Whenever the posts are to be filled up by deputation/direct recruitment, the posts shall be 
advertised in the website of RIPANS and newspapers by such appropriate methods as the Institute authority 
deems fit. In case of receipt of large number of applications, the Director may constitute a Screening 
Committee, which will short-list the candidates. 


In case of direct recruitment, the selection shall be transparent by giving specific marks for various 
parameters decided by the Selection Committee, keeping in view the job requirement for the post. The 
Selection Committee as constituted by competent authority will hold interviews of the all-eligible candidates, 
as may be required. 


Vacancies caused by the incumbent being away on deputation or long illness or study leave or under other 
circumstances, for duration of one year or more, can be filled on deputation/short term contract. 


Age limit for direct recruitments: - 


The upper age limit for direct recruitment in each category of post shall be as specified in Schedule I. The 
upper age limit in respect of Schedule Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes and the other 
special categories of persons etc, shall be relaxable in accordance with the orders issued by the Central 
Government from time to time. 


Unless otherwise specified in the Recruitment Rules, age relaxation of 5 years will be allowed for personnel 
serving in Central/State Government and Autonomous Institutions of Central & State Governments. 


The crucial date for determining the age limit shall be the closing date for receipt of application from 
candidates. 


Method of Recruitment: 


The method of recruitment, age limit, qualifications and other matters relating to the said post shall be 
specified in column 5 to |3 of the said schedule. 


In case of direct recruitment, the selected candidates, from the date of assuming the duties will be on 
probation initially for a minimum period as specified in Schedule I. At the end of probation period, the 
candidate’s performance will be assessed by the Institute authority to decide if the candidate’s performance 
during the probation period has been satisfactory or otherwise. If his/her performance is found to be 
satisfactory, he/she will be confirmed for regular appointment on completion of probation.

पे-मैट्रिक्स में पदों की संख्या, वर्गीकरण और स्तर:- 

पदों की संख्या, उसका वर्गीकरण और उससे जुड़े पे-मैट्रिक्स में स्तर अनुसूची | में निहित संबंधित पदों में निर्दिष्ट 
होगा। ग्रुप AV के रूप में पदों का वर्गीकरण केंद्र सरकार के वेतन स्तर में समान श्रेणियों के अनुरूप होगा। 

भर्ती मानदंड:- 

सभी पदों के लिए न्यूनतम शैक्षणिक योग्यता अनुसूची । में निर्दिष्ट के अनुसार होगी। संबंधित पद के लिए 
आवश्यक आरआईपीएएनएस के संबंध में गैर संकाय के हित के संबंधित क्षेत्रों में शैक्षिक योग्यता के लिए निर्दिष्ट 
अनुशासन, पदों के विज्ञापित होने से पहले अनुसूची | में दिया जाएगा। मान्यता प्राप्त विश्वविद्यालय और नियामक 
निकायों की शैक्षिक योग्यता, यथास्थिति, केवल स्वीकार किया जाएगा। शैक्षिक योग्यता के संबंध में किसी भी 
संदेह की स्थिति में, नियुक्ति प्राधिकारी का निर्णय अंतिम और बाध्यकारी होगा। 

सभी पदों के लिए आवश्यक अनुभव अनुसूची | में निर्दिष्ट अनुसार होगा। पद के लिए अपेक्षित अनुभव निर्धारित 
करने की निर्णायक तिथि अभ्यर्थी से आवेदन प्राप्त करने की अंतिम तिथि होगी। 

भर्ती अनुसूची । में निर्धारित अनुसार की जाएगी। जब भी पद सीधी भर्ती द्वारा भरा जाना हो, तो पदों का 
विज्ञापन आरआईपीएएनएस की वेबसाइट और समाचार पत्रों में ऐसे उचित तरीकों से किया जाएगा जो संस्थान 
प्राधिकरण उचित समझे। बड़ी संख्या में आवेदन प्राप्त होने की स्थिति में, निदेशक एक स्क्रीनिंग कमेटी का गठन 
कर सकते हैं, जो अभ्यर्थियों का चयन करेगी। 

सीधी भर्ती के मामले में, पद के लिए नौकरी की आवश्यकता को ध्यान में रखते हुए चयन समिति द्वारा तय किए 
गए विभिन्न मापदंडों के लिए विशिष्ट अंक देकर चयन पारदर्शी होगा। सक्षम प्राधिकारी द्वारा गठित चयन समिति 
सभी पात्र अभ्यर्थियों के साक्षात्कार, जैसा आवश्यक हो, आयोजित करेगी। 

पदधारी के प्रतिनियुक्ति या लंबी बीमारी या अध्ययन अवकाश या अन्य परिस्थितियों में एक वर्ष या उससे अधिक 
की अवधि के लिए दूर रहने के कारण होने वाली रिक्तियों को प्रतिनियुक्ति।अल्पकालिक अनुबंध पर भरा जा 
सकता है। 

सीधी भर्ती हेतु आयु सीमा:- 

प्रत्येक श्रेणी के पद में सीधी भर्ती के लिए अधिकतम आयु सीमा अनुसूची | में निर्दिष्ट के अनुसार होगी। अनुसूचित 
जाति, अनुसूचित जनजाति, अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग और अन्य विशेष श्रेणियों के व्यक्तियों आदि के संबंध में अधिकतम 
आयु सीमा में केंद्र सरकार द्वारा समय-समय पर जारी आदेशों के अनुसार छूट दी जाएगी। 

जब तक भर्ती नियमों में अन्यथा निर्दिष्ट न हो, केंद्र/राज्य सरकार और केंद्र और राज्य सरकारों के स्वायत्त संस्थानों 
में सेवारत कर्मियों के लिए आयु में 5 वर्ष की छूट की अनुमति होगी। 

आयु सीमा निर्धारित करने की निर्णायक तिथि अभ्यर्थियों से आवेदन प्राप्त करने की अंतिम तिथि होगी। 

भर्ती की विधि: 

उक्त पदों पर भर्ती की विधि, आयु सीमा, योग्यता और अन्य मामले उक्त अनुसूची के कॉलम 5 से 3 में निर्दिष्ट 
किए जाएंगे। 

सीधी भर्ती के मामले में, चयनित अभ्यर्थी, कार्यभार ग्रहण करने की तिथि से, प्रारंभ में अनुसूची | में निर्दिष्ट 
न्यूनतम अवधि के लिए परिवीक्षा पर होंगे। परिवीक्षा अवधि के अंत में, अभ्यर्थी के प्रदर्शन का मूल्यांकन संस्थान 
प्राधिकरण द्वारा किया जाएगा ताकि यह तय किया जा सके कि परिवीक्षा अवधि के दौरान अभ्यर्थी का प्रदर्शन 
संतोषजनक रहा है या अन्यथा। यदि उसका कार्य संतोषजनक पाया जाता है तो परिवीक्षा अवधि पूर्ण होने पर 
उसकी नियमित नियुक्ति की पुष्टि की जायेगी। 

अनुसूची | में निर्दिष्ट न्यूनतम योग्यता और अनुभव रखने वाले अभ्यर्थी के अधीन, अन्य केंद्र सरकार/ राज्य सरकार 
के अभ्यर्थियों को प्रतिनियुक्ति के आधार पर लिया जा सकता है। प्रतिनियुक्ति की अवधि तीन वर्ष की अवधि के 
लिए होगी जिसे निदेशक द्वारा ऋण देने वाले विभाग की सहमति से सेवा की अत्यावश्यकता में पांच वर्ष तक 
बढ़ाया जा सकता है।

NOTIFICATION 
Aizawl, the 3rd November, 2023 


No. A.208/2/2023-Estt/RIPANS/)84.—In exercise of the powers conferred by the proviso to article 309 
of the Constitution and as approved by the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India vide Letter 
F.No.U.202/57/2022-NE -Part (9) dated 25.09.2023, the President hereby makes the following amendment of the 
method of recruitment of the post of Assistant Accounts Officer in Regional Institute of Paramedical & Nursing 
Sciences, Aizawl, an Autonomous Institute under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India, 
namely:- 


I. Short Title and commencement: - 
४8 These rules may be called the Recruitment Rules of Group ‘B’ Non - Faculty Post (Assistant Accounts 
Officer), Regional Institute of Paramedical & Nursing Sciences, Aizawl, Mizoram, 2023. 
.2. They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 
2. The number of posts, classification and level in the Pay Matrix: - 


The number of the said posts, their classification and the level in the Pay Matrix attached thereto shall be as 
specified in Schedule I. The classification of posts as Group ‘B’ will correspond to similar categories in the 
Pay Level of Central Government. 


3. Recruitment Norms: - 


3.] The minimum educational qualification for all the posts shall be as specified in Schedule I. The specified 
discipline for educational qualification in related areas of interest of the faculty in respect of RIPANS, 
required for the post concerned, will be as given in Schedule I, before the posts are advertised. Educational 
qualifications of recognized University and regulating Statutory Bodies, as the case may be, will only be 
accepted. In case of any doubt regarding educational qualification, the decision of Appointing Authority will 
be final and binding. 


3.2 The experience required for all the posts shall as specified in Schedule I. The crucial date for determining the 
experience required for the post shall be the closing date for receipt of application from candidates. 


3.3 Recruitment shall be made by promotion/deputation/direct recruitment as the case may be, as prescribed in 
Schedule I. Whenever the posts are to be filled up by deputation/direct recruitment, the posts shall be 
advertised in the website of RIPANS and newspapers by such appropriate methods as the Institute authority 
deems fit. In case of receipt of large number of applications, the Director may constitute a Screening 
Committee, which will short-list the candidates. 


3.4 In case of direct recruitment, the selection shall be transparent by giving specific marks for various 
parameters decided by the Selection Committee, keeping in view the job requirement for the post. The 
Selection Committee as constituted by competent authority will hold interviews of the all-eligible candidates, 
as may be required. 


3.5 Vacancies caused by the incumbent being away on deputation or long illness or study leave or under other 
circumstances, for duration of one year or more, can be filled on deputation/short term contract. 


Age limit for direct recruitments: - 


4.] The upper age limit for direct recruitment in each category of post shall be as specified in Schedule I. The 
upper age limit in respect of Schedule Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes and the other 
special categories of persons etc, shall be relaxable in accordance with the orders issued by the Central 
Government from time to time. 


Unless otherwise specified in the Recruitment Rules, age relaxation of 5 years will be allowed for personnel 
serving in Central/State Government and Autonomous Institutions of Central & State Governments. 


4.2 The crucial date for determining the age limit shall be the closing date for receipt of application from 
candidates. 

5. Method of Recruitment: 

5. The method of recruitment, age limit, qualifications and other matters relating to the said post shall be 


specified in column 5 to I3 of the said schedule. 


5:2 In case of direct recruitment, the selected candidates, from the date of assuming the duties will be on 
probation initially for a minimum period as specified in Schedule I. At the end of probation period, the 
candidate’s performance will be assessed by the Institute authority to decide if the candidate’s performance

during the probation period has been satisfactory or otherwise. If his/her performance is found to be 
satisfactory, he/she will be confirmed for regular appointment on completion of probation. 


5.3 Subject to the candidate having minimum qualification and experience as specified in Schedule I, candidates 
from other Central Government/State Government can be taken on deputation basis. The period of deputation 
shall be for a period of three years which may be extended by the Director up to five years in the exigencies 
of service taking the consent of the lending department. 

6. Disqualification: - 
No person: 
(a) Who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living, or 
(b) Who having a spouse living, has entered in or contracted a marriage with any other person, shall be 

eligible for appointment to any of the said posts; 

Provided that RIPANS may, if satisfied that such a marriage is permissible under the personal law applicable 
to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt any 
person from the operation of this rule. 

7. Interpretation: - 
Where any doubt arises as to the interpretation of any of the provisions of these rules, the matter shall be 
referred to Appointing Authority whose decision shall be final. 

8. Power to relax: - 
Where the duly constituted Selection Committee of RIPANS is of the opinion that it is necessary or 
expedient to do so, it may for reasons to be recorded in writing, relax any of the provisions of these rules with 
respect to any class or category of posts mentioned in Schedule I. This will be subject to acceptance of the 
Appointing Authority. 

9. Saving: - 

Nothing in these rules shall affect reservations, relaxation of age limit and other concessions required to be 
provided to candidates belonging to the Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes, Ex- 
Servicemen and other special categories of persons in accordance with the orders issued by the Central 
Government from time to time in this regard. The posts filled earlier will not be affected by these 
Recruitment Rules, which are being notified now. The job descriptions pertaining to various posts would be 
issued separately by RIPANS as an Office Order.

No. A.208/2/2023-Estt/RIPANS/)85.—In exercise of the powers conferred by the proviso to article 309 
of the Constitution and as approved by the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India vide Letter 
F.No.U.202/57/2022-NE -Part (9) dated 25.09.2023, the President hereby makes the following amendment of the 
method of recruitment of the post of Junior Accounts Officer in Regional Institute of Paramedical & Nursing 
Sciences, Aizawl, an Autonomous Institute under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India, 
namely:- 


. Short Title and commencement: - 
4:४8 These rules may be called the Recruitment Rules of Group “B’ Non - Faculty Post (Junior Accounts Officer), 
Regional Institute of Paramedical & Nursing Sciences, Aizawl, Mizoram, 2023. 
.2. They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 
2. The number of posts, classification and level in the Pay Matrix: - 


The number of the said posts, their classification and the level in the Pay Matrix attached thereto shall be as 
specified in Schedule I. The classification of posts as Group ‘B’ will correspond to similar categories in the 
Pay Level of Central Government. 


3. Recruitment Norms: - 


3.] The minimum educational qualification for all the posts shall be as specified in Schedule I. The specified 
discipline for educational qualification in related areas of interest of the faculty in respect of RIPANS, 
required for the post concerned, will be as given in Schedule I, before the posts are advertised. Educational 
qualifications of recognized University and regulating Statutory Bodies, as the case may be, will only be 
accepted. In case of any doubt regarding educational qualification, the decision of Appointing Authority will 
be final and binding. 


3.2 The experience required for all the posts shall as specified in Schedule I. The crucial date for determining the 
experience required for the post shall be the closing date for receipt of application from candidates. 


3.3 Recruitment shall be made by promotion/deputation/direct recruitment as the case may be, as prescribed in 
Schedule I. Whenever the posts are to be filled up by deputation/direct recruitment, the posts shall be 
advertised in the website of RIPANS and newspapers by such appropriate methods as the Institute authority 
deems fit. In case of receipt of large number of applications, the Director may constitute a Screening 
Committee, which will short-list the candidates. 


3.4 In case of direct recruitment, the selection shall be transparent by giving specific marks for various 
parameters decided by the Selection Committee, keeping in view the job requirement for the post. The 
Selection Committee as constituted by competent authority will hold interviews of the all-eligible candidates, 
as may be required. 


3.5 Vacancies caused by the incumbent being away on deputation or long illness or study leave or under other 
circumstances, for duration of one year or more, can be filled on deputation/short term contract. 


Age limit for direct recruitments: - 


4.] The upper age limit for direct recruitment in each category of post shall be as specified in Schedule I. The 
upper age limit in respect of Schedule Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes and the other 
special categories of persons etc, shall be relaxable in accordance with the orders issued by the Central 
Government from time to time. 


Unless otherwise specified in the Recruitment Rules, age relaxation of 5 years will be allowed for personnel 
serving in Central/State Government and Autonomous Institutions of Central & State Governments. 


4.2 The crucial date for determining the age limit shall be the closing date for receipt of application from 
candidates. 

5. Method of Recruitment: 

5. The method of recruitment, age limit, qualifications and other matters relating to the said post shall be 


specified in column 5 to |3 of the said schedule. 


5:2 In case of direct recruitment, the selected candidates, from the date of assuming the duties will be on 
probation initially for a minimum period as specified in Schedule I. At the end of probation period, the 
candidate’s performance will be assessed by the Institute authority to decide if the candidate’s performance

satisfactory, he/she will be confirmed for regular appointment on completion of probation. 


5.3 Subject to the candidate having minimum qualification and experience as specified in Schedule I, candidates 
from other Central Government/State Government can be taken on deputation basis. The period of deputation 
shall be for a period of three years which may be extended by the Director up to five years in the exigencies 
of service taking the consent of the lending department. 

6. Disqualification: - 
No person: 
(a) Who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living, or 
(b) Who having a spouse living, has entered in or contracted a marriage with any other person, shall be 

eligible for appointment to any of the said posts; 

Provided that RIPANS may, if satisfied that such a marriage is permissible under the personal law applicable 
to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt any 
person from the operation of this rule. 

7. Interpretation: - 
Where any doubt arises as to the interpretation of any of the provisions of these rules, the matter shall be 
referred to Appointing Authority whose decision shall be final. 

8. Power to relax: - 
Where the duly constituted Selection Committee of RIPANS is of the opinion that it is necessary or 
expedient to do so, it may for reasons to be recorded in writing, relax any of the provisions of these rules with 
respect to any class or category of posts mentioned in Schedule I. This will be subject to acceptance of the 
Appointing Authority. 

9. Saving: - 

Nothing in these rules shall affect reservations, relaxation of age limit and other concessions required to be 
provided to candidates belonging to the Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes, Ex- 
Servicemen and other special categories of persons in accordance with the orders issued by the Central 
Government from time to time in this regard. The posts filled earlier will not be affected by these 
Recruitment Rules, which are being notified now. The job descriptions pertaining to various posts would be 
issued separately by RIPANS as an Office Order.

engaged in the ‘Banking’, which is covered under item 2 of the First Schedule to the Industrial Disputes Act, 947 
(4 of 947), to be a public utility service for the purposes of the said Act; 


And whereas the Central Government had declared the said industry to be public utility service for the 
purposes of the said Act for a period of six months with effect from the 5" June, 2023 vide notification of the 
Government of India in the Ministry of Labour and Employment published in the gazette of India, part-II, section 3, 
sub-section (ii) vide number S.O. 2432 (E), dated the 5" June, 2023; 


And whereas the Central Government is of the opinion that public interest requires the extension of the 
public utility service status to the said industry for a further period of six months; 


Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by the proviso to sub-clause (vi) of clause (n) of 
section 2 of the Industrial Disputes Act, 947 (/4 of 947), the Central Government hereby declares the services 
engaged in the Banking industry to be a public utility service for the purposes of the said Act for a period of 
six months with effect from the 5™ December, 2023.

MINISTRY OF ENVIRONMENT, FOREST AND CLIMATE CHANGE 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the I5th December, 2023 
G.S.R. 895(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by sections 6 and 25 of the Environment (Protection) 


act, [986 (29 of 986) the Central Government hereby makes the following rules further to amend the Environment 
(Protection) Rules, 986, namely: - 


l. Short title and commencement.-- (l) These rules may be called the Environment (Protection) Sixth 
Amendment Rules, 2023. 


(2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 


2. In the Environment (Protection) Rules, 986, in the SCHEDULE-I, in entry at Sl. No. 74, for note no. 2, the 
following entry shall be substituted, namely: - 


"2. The existing brick kilns which are not following zig-zag technology or vertical shaft or use piped natural gas 
as fuel in brick making shall be converted to zig-zag technology or vertical shaft or use piped natural gas as fuel in 
brick making within a period of : 


(a) one year w.e.f. 23.02.2023 in case of kilns located within ten kilometers radius of non-attainment cities; except 


those located in million plus population cities, NCR districts, and critically & severally polluted areas as 
categorized by CPCB; 


(b) one year w.e.f. 23.02.2024 in case of other kilns. 


Provided that in case where Commission for Air Quality Management / Central Pollution Control Board / 
State Pollution Control Board / Pollution Control Committee has separately issued more stringent Norms/ 
timelines, such orders shall prevail. " 


[F. No. Q-507/35/2007-CPW] 
NARESH PAL GANGWAR, Addl. Secy.

44(E) dated the 057 June, 2023.

, Maintenance , management & operation of the special railway project, namely New Line between Anandnager — 
Ghughli via Maharajganj New B.G. Line ( 52.70 km) special Railway Project between CH:5.00 M. — CH: 2.l4 M 
of North Eastern Railway, in Maharajganj district of the State of Uttar Pradesh, hereby declares its intention to 
acquire such land.. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within thirty days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, raise objection to the acquisition and use of such land for the aforesaid purpose 
under Section 20D subsection (l) of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Dy.Land Acquisition Officer 
(Joint Organization)District Maharajganj Uttar Pradesh in writing and shall set out the grounds there of, and the 
competent authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by legal practitioner 
and may after hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the competent authority 
thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order by the Competent Authority under subsection (2) of Section 20D of the said Act shall be final 
u/s 20D subsection (3). 
The land plans and other details of the land covered under this notification are available, and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

S.O. 5332(E).—Whereas, by the notification of the Government of India, in the Ministry of Railways (North 
Central Railway, Construction department), Notification number, S.O. 4244 (E) dated the 19" September, 2023 
published in Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, section 3 Sub-section (ii), dated the 27 September, 2023 
(hereinafter referred to as the said notification) and issued under sub-section (1) of section 20A of the Railways

(Amendment) Act, 2008 (11 of 2008) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declares its 
intention to acquire the land specified in the schedule annexed to the said notification for the purpose of execution, 
maintenance, management and operation of Special Railway Project, namely special railway project of Prayagraj-Pt. 
Deendayal 37 line doubling Railway project (150 km) in District Chandauli in the state of Uttar Pradesh. 


And whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in daily newspapers namely “Hindustan” 
and “Hindustan Times” Dated 17 October, 2023 under sub section (4) of section 204 of the said Act; 


And whereas, All the objections received in this project have been disposed of by the competent authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section 20E of the said Act, the Competent Authority has submitted its 
report to the Central Government; 


Now therefore, upon receipt of the report of the Competent Authority, and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by sub-section (1) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the lands 
specified in the schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the official Gazette, the land specified in the schedule annexed 
hereto shall vest absolutely in the Central government free from all encumbrances. 


And, that all persons interested in the above mentioned land in pursuance of sub-section (04) of section 20 
(F) of the said Act by the Central Government are hereby informed that they may, personally or through an agent or 
legal practitioner, be notified by the competent authority Sub District Magistrate, Pt. Deen Dayal Upadhyay 
Nagar, can submit his claim in the next 20 days from the date of publication of this notification in the office of the 
Competent Authority.

का.आ. 5335(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ 5884 (अ) तारीख 16 दिसंबर 2022 जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग 1, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (9) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा उत्तर प्रदेश राज्य के बस्ती जिले में रिंग रोड (प्रथम 
चरण),के (कि.मी. 0.00 से कि.मी. 22.15) तक के निर्माण (4-लेन का बनाना आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के 
लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "28 जनवरी 
2023 को "हिन्दुस्तान टाइम्स" और "अमर उजाला" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है;

अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 15th December, 2023 


8.0. 5337(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 277 (E) Dated:17th January 2023, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, 
Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/two/four-lane with paved shoulder, etc.,), 
maintenance, management and operation of Gowrelly-Valigonda section of NH930P in the stretch of land from 
Km. 0.000 to Km. 5.585 (Revenue Divisional Officer, Ibrahimpatnam) in the district of RANGA REDDY in the 
state of TELANGANA. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Hindu”(English) and 
“Namastey Telangana”(Telugu) both dated 05th March 2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


10 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)] 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Competent Authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

उपर्युक्त उल्लिखित अधिकारी समय-समय पर यथासंशोधित केंद्रीय विद्युत प्राधिकरण (सुरक्षा और विद्युत आपूर्ति

वैद्युत कार्यों, वैद्युत संस्थापनाओं तथा वैद्युत रोलिंग स्टॉक के संबंध में अपने अधिकारों का प्रयोग करते हुए अपने कार्य 
निष्पादित करेंगे। 


यह सुनिश्चित किया जाएगा कि श्री ध्वनित शर्मा, डीजीएम (ईएंडएम) जीएमआरसीएल के रूप में उन्हें सौंपे गए

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 5th December, 2023 


59.0. 5338(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways Number 8.0.8(0), dated 97 January 2023, has been published in the Gazette of India, 
Extraordinary, Part II, section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3(A) of the National 
Highways Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its 
intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for Land to be Acquired for 
building (widening/four laning, etc) Maintenance, Management and operation of NH-66 on the stretch of land 
from Km. 555/200 to Km. 56/890 (existing Km. 555/200 (end of Madgao Western Bypass, Navelim) to Km. 
56/960 Uskini Band, Cuncolim) in the State of Goa. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Goan” ; “Bhanagar Bhuin” 
and “Tarun Bharat” dated 4/0/2023, under sub-section (3) of section 3(A) of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section () of section 3(D) of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section () of section 3(D) of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub - section (2) of section 3 (D) of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 15th December, 2023 


S.O. 5344(E).— In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National 


Highways Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being 
satisfied that for the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is 
required for building (widening/two/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of Principally 
Declared National Highway 166H on the stretch of land from Km 0.000 to Km. 29.600 (Section Peth Naka - 
Karandwadi) in the district of Sangli in the State of Maharashtra hereby declares its intention to acquire such land; 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section (1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the competent authority, namely, the Special Land Acquisition 
Officer-1, Sangli in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the competent authority shall give the objector an 
opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and 
after making such further enquiry, if any, as the competent authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or 
disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the competent authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land covered under this notification are available and can be inspected 
by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the competent authority.

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the I5th December, 2023 


9.0. 534I(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 5928 Dated:9/2/2022 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of !956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation 
of NHNE 4C in the stretch of land from Km. 3!.94 to Km. 70 (DM Office Jaipur) in the district of JAIPUR in the 
state of RAJASTHAN 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Dainik navajyoti” and “Rajashthan 
Patrika”’ both dated /5/02/2023 under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 


submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 


specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 


vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

S.O. 5345(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) of Section 3A of the National 
Highways Act, 1956 (48 of 1956), (thereinafter referred to as the said Act,) the Central Government after being 
satisfied that for the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required 
for the Land Acquisition for four lanning of NH - 66 from km. 570/000 (Bendordem ) to Km. 584/715 (Start of 
Canacona Bypass) on NH - 66 in the State of Goa. of NH-17 (NH-66) in the state of Goa.I hereby declare its intention 
to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section (1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the competent authority, namely, Special Land Acquisition Officer, 
National Highways, (SLAO, NHs) PWD (Cell), Altinho, Panaji- Goa. in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof 
and the competent authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal 
practitioner, and may after hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the competent 
authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the competent authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land covered under this notification are available and can be inspected 
by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the competent authority.

New Delhi, the I5th December, 2023 


S.O. 5353(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section () of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of Greenfield 
Highway in the stretch of land from Km. !.28 to Km. 5.85 (Collectorate Ballia) in the district of BALLIA in the state 
of UTTAR PRADESH, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section() of 


section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, ADM (F/R) in writing and shall set 
out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in 
person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if 


any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 
The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 


inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 15th December, 2023 

9.0. 5340(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub- 
section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), Vide 
5.0. No. 3400 (E) dated 28" July 2023, the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for construction of (Widening two / four laning etc,) Maintenance, 
management and operation of NH731A (RAM VAN GAMAN PATH) on the stretch of land from Km 49.155 to 
112.950 ( Sub Divisional Magistrate , Sirthu ( Judicial), District HQ - Manjhanpur ) in the District of Kaushambi in 
the state of UTTAR PRADESH 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Amarujala ” and “ The Times of 
India ” both dated 11" August 2023 under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been receivedand the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

का.आ. 5336(अ).-- केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 956 (4956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके

परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ.4475(अ) तारीख 24.09.2023, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग ॥, खण्ड 3, उपखंड () में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा महाराष्ट्र राज्य के कोल्हापूर जिले में NH-548 H 
के कि.मी. 409/00 से कि.मी. 37/00 तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के दो लेन तथा पेव्हड शोल्डर का निर्माण, अनुरक्षण, 
प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की 
घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "47.40.2023 " 
को "दैनिक सिंधुदुर्ग समाचार " और "दैनिक राष्ट्रगीत " दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ की उपधारा () के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को 
अपनी रिपोर्ट दे दी है;

की STAT (॥) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए; 


और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी।

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 15th December, 2023 


S.O. 5342(E).— In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for 
building (widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation 
of NH167B in the stretch of land from Km. 143.320 to Km. 189.050 of Malakonda to Singarayakonda Section in the 
district of Prakasam in the state of Andhra Pradesh, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Joint Collector I, Prakasam District 
in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of 
being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making 
such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the 
objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

सभी पदों के लिए न्यूनतम शैक्षणिक योग्यता अनुसूची । में निर्दिष्ट के अनुसार होगी। संबंधित पद के लिए आवश्यक 
आरआईपीएएनएस के संबंध में गैर संकाय के हित के संबंधित क्षेत्रों में शैक्षिक योग्यता के लिए निर्दिष्ट अनुशासन, पदों के 
विज्ञापित होने से पहले अनुसूची | में दिया जाएगा। मान्यता प्राप्त विश्वविद्यालय और नियामक निकायों की शैक्षिक योग्यता, 
यथास्थिति, केवल स्वीकार किया जाएगा। शैक्षिक योग्यता के संबंध में किसी भी संदेह की स्थिति में, नियुक्ति प्राधिकारी का 
निर्णय अंतिम और बाध्यकारी होगा। 

सभी पदों के लिए आवश्यक अनुभव अनुसूची | में निर्दिष्ट अनुसार होगा। पद के लिए अपेक्षित अनुभव निर्धारित करने की 
निर्णायक तिथि अभ्यर्थी से आवेदन प्राप्त करने की अंतिम तिथि होगी। 


भर्ती अनुसूची | में निर्धारित अनुसार की जाएगी। जब भी पद सीधी भर्ती द्वारा भरा जाना हो, तो पदों का विज्ञापन 
आरआईपीएएनएस की वेबसाइट और समाचार पत्रों में ऐसे उचित तरीकों से किया जाएगा जो संस्थान प्राधिकरण उचित 
समझे। बड़ी संख्या में आवेदन प्राप्त होने की स्थिति में, निदेशक एक स्क्रीनिंग कमेटी का गठन कर सकते हैं, जो अभ्यर्थियों का 
चयन करेगी। 

सीधी भर्ती के मामले में, पद के लिए नौकरी की आवश्यकता को ध्यान में रखते हुए चयन समिति द्वारा तय किए गए विभिन्न 
मापदंडों के लिए विशिष्ट अंक देकर चयन पारदर्शी होगा। सक्षम प्राधिकारी द्वारा गठित चयन समिति सभी पात्र अभ्यर्थियों के 
साक्षात्कार, जैसा आवश्यक हो, आयोजित करेगी। 


पदधारी के प्रतिनियुक्ति या लंबी बीमारी या अध्ययन अवकाश या अन्य परिस्थितियों में एक वर्ष या उससे अधिक की अवधि 
के लिए दूर रहने के कारण होने वाली रिक्तियों को प्रतिनियुक्ति/अल्पकालिक अनुबंध पर भरा जा सकता है। 

सीधी भर्ती हेतु आयु सीमा:- 

प्रत्येक श्रेणी के पद में सीधी भर्ती के लिए अधिकतम आयु सीमा अनुसूची | में निर्दिष्ट के अनुसार होगी। अनुसूचित जाति, 
अनुसूचित जनजाति, अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग और अन्य विशेष श्रेणियों के व्यक्तियों आदि के संबंध में अधिकतम आयु सीमा में केंद्र 
सरकार द्वारा समय-समय पर जारी आदेशों के अनुसार छूट दी जाएगी। 


जब तक भर्ती नियमों में अन्यथा निर्दिष्ट न हो, केंद्र/राज्य सरकार और केंद्र और राज्य सरकारों के स्वायत्त संस्थानों में सेवारत 
कर्मियों के लिए आयु में 5 वर्ष की छूट की अनुमति होगी। 

आयु सीमा निर्धारित करने की निर्णायक तिथि अभ्यर्थियों से आवेदन प्राप्त करने की अंतिम तिथि होगी। 

भर्ती की विधि: 

उक्त पदों पर भर्ती की विधि, आयु सीमा, योग्यता और अन्य मामले उक्त अनुसूची के कॉलम 5 से 3 में निर्दिष्ट किए जाएंगे। 


सीधी भर्ती के मामले में, चयनित अभ्यर्थी, कार्यभार ग्रहण करने की तिथि से, प्रारंभ में अनुसूची | में निर्दिष्ट न्यूनतम अवधि के 
लिए परिवीक्षा पर होंगे। परिवीक्षा अवधि के अंत में, अभ्यर्थी के प्रदर्शन का मूल्यांकन संस्थान प्राधिकरण द्वारा किया जाएगा 


ताकि यह तय किया जा सके कि परिवीक्षा अवधि के दौरान अभ्यर्थी का प्रदर्शन संतोषजनक रहा है या अन्यथा। यदि उसका 
कार्य संतोषजनक पाया जाता है तो परिवीक्षा अवधि पूर्ण होने पर उसकी नियमित नियुक्ति की पुष्टि की जायेगी। 


अनुसूची । में निर्दिष्ट न्यूनतम योग्यता और अनुभव रखने वाले अभ्यर्थी के अधीन, अन्य केंद्र सरकार/ राज्य सरकार के

The number of posts, classification and level in the Pay Matrix: - 


The number of the said posts, their classification and the level in the Pay Matrix attached thereto shall be as 
specified in Schedule I. The classification of posts as Group ‘A’ will correspond to similar categories in the 
Pay Level of Central Government. 


Recruitment Norms: - 


The minimum educational qualification for all the posts shall be as specified in Schedule I. The specified 
discipline for educational qualification in related areas of interest of the faculty in respect of RIPANS, 
required for the post concerned, will be as given in Schedule I, before the posts are advertised. Educational 
qualifications of recognized University and regulating Statutory Bodies, as the case may be, will only be 
accepted. In case of any doubt regarding educational qualification, the decision of Appointing Authority will 
be final and binding. 


The experience required for all the posts shall as specified in Schedule I. The crucial date for determining the 
experience required for the post shall be the closing date for receipt of application from candidates. 


Recruitment shall be made by promotion/deputation/direct recruitment as the case may be, as prescribed in 
Schedule I. Whenever the posts are to be filled up by deputation/direct recruitment, the posts shall be 
advertised in the website of RIPANS and newspapers by such appropriate methods as the Institute authority 
deems fit. In case of receipt of large number of applications, the Director may constitute a Screening 
Committee, which will short-list the candidates. 


In case of direct recruitment, the selection shall be transparent by giving specific marks for various 
parameters decided by the Selection Committee, keeping in view the job requirement for the post. The 
Selection Committee as constituted by competent authority will hold interviews of the all-eligible candidates, 
as may be required. 


Vacancies caused by the incumbent being away on deputation or long illness or study leave or under other 
circumstances, for duration of one year or more, can be filled on deputation/short term contract. 


Age limit for direct recruitments: - 


The upper age limit for direct recruitment in each category of post shall be as specified in Schedule I. The 
upper age limit in respect of Schedule Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes and the other 
special categories of persons etc, shall be relaxable in accordance with the orders issued by the Central 
Government from time to time. 


Unless otherwise specified in the Recruitment Rules, age relaxation of 5 years will be allowed for personnel 
serving in Central/State Government and Autonomous Institutions of Central & State Governments. 


The crucial date for determining the age limit shall be the closing date for receipt of application from 
candidates. 


Method of Recruitment: 


The method of recruitment, age limit, qualifications and other matters relating to the said post shall be 
specified in column 5 to I3 of the said schedule. 


In case of direct recruitment, the selected candidates, from the date of assuming the duties will be on 
probation initially for a minimum period as specified in Schedule I. At the end of probation period, the 
candidate’s performance will be assessed by the Institute authority to decide if the candidate’s performance 
during the probation period has been satisfactory or otherwise. If his/her performance is found to be 
satisfactory, he/she will be confirmed for regular appointment on completion of probation. 


Subject to the candidate having minimum qualification and experience as specified in Schedule I, candidates 
from other Central Government/State Government can be taken on deputation basis. The period of deputation 
shall be for a period of three years which may be extended by the Director up to five years in the exigencies 
of service taking the consent of the lending department. 


Disqualification: - 
No person: 


(a) Who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living, or

Provided that RIPANS may, if satisfied that such a marriage is permissible under the personal law applicable 
to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt any 
person from the operation of this rule. 


Interpretation: - 


Where any doubt arises as to the interpretation of any of the provisions of these rules, the matter shall be 
referred to Appointing Authority whose decision shall be final. 


Power to relax: - 


Where the duly constituted Selection Committee of RIPANS is of the opinion that it is necessary or 
expedient to do so, it may for reasons to be recorded in writing, relax any of the provisions of these rules with 
respect to any class or category of posts mentioned in Schedule I. This will be subject to acceptance of the 
Appointing Authority. 


Saving: - 


Nothing in these rules shall affect reservations, relaxation of age limit and other concessions required to be 
provided to candidates belonging to the Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes, Ex- 
Servicemen and other special categories of persons in accordance with the orders issued by the Central 
Government from time to time in this regard. The posts filled earlier will not be affected by these 
Recruitment Rules, which are being notified now. The job descriptions pertaining to various posts would be 
issued separately by RIPANS as an Office Order.

सभी पदों के लिए न्यूनतम शैक्षणिक योग्यता अनुसूची । में निर्दिष्ट के अनुसार होगी। संबंधित पद के लिए आवश्यक 
आरआईपीएएनएस के संबंध में गैर संकाय के हित के संबंधित क्षेत्रों में शैक्षिक योग्यता के लिए निर्दिष्ट अनुशासन, पदों के 
विज्ञापित होने से पहले अनुसूची ८ में दिया जाएगा। मान्यता प्राप्त विश्वविद्यालय और नियामक निकायों की शैक्षिक योग्यताए 
यथास्थितिए केवल स्वीकार किया जाएगा। शैक्षिक योग्यता के संबंध में किसी भी संदेह की स्थिति Ay नियुक्ति प्राधिकारी का 
निर्णय अंतिम और बाध्यकारी होगा। 


सभी पदों के लिए आवश्यक अनुभव अनुसूची । में निर्दिष्ट अनुसार होगा। पद के लिए अपेक्षित अनुभव निर्धारित करने की 
निर्णायक तिथि अभ्यर्थी से आवेदन प्राप्त करने की अंतिम तिथि होगी। 


भर्ती अनुसूची | में निर्धारित अनुसार की जाएगी। जब भी पद सीधी भर्ती द्वारा भरा जाना हो, तो पदों का विज्ञापन

समझे। बड़ी संख्या में आवेदन प्राप्त होने की स्थिति में, निदेशक एक स्क्रीनिंग कमेटी का गठन कर सकते हैं, जो अभ्यर्थियों का

Short Title and commencement: - 


These rules may be called the Recruitment Rules of Group ‘B’ Non - Faculty Post (Assistant Administrative 
Officer), Regional Institute of Paramedical & Nursing Sciences, Aizawl, Mizoram, 2023. 


They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 
The number of posts, classification and level in the Pay Matrix: - 


The number of the said posts, their classification and the level in the Pay Matrix attached thereto shall be as 
specified in Schedule I. The classification of posts as Group ‘B’ will correspond to similar categories in the 
Pay Level of Central Government. 


Recruitment Norms: - 


The minimum educational qualification for all the posts shall be as specified in Schedule I. The specified 
discipline for educational qualification in related areas of interest of the faculty in respect of RIPANS, 
required for the post concerned, will be as given in Schedule I, before the posts are advertised. Educational 
qualifications of recognized University and regulating Statutory Bodies, as the case may be, will only be 
accepted. In case of any doubt regarding educational qualification, the decision of Appointing Authority will 
be final and binding. 


The experience required for all the posts shall as specified in Schedule I. The crucial date for determining the 
experience required for the post shall be the closing date for receipt of application from candidates. 


Recruitment shall be made by promotion/deputation/direct recruitment as the case may be, as prescribed in 
Schedule I. Whenever the posts are to be filled up by deputation/direct recruitment, the posts shall be 
advertised in the website of RIPANS and newspapers by such appropriate methods as the Institute authority 
deems fit. In case of receipt of large number of applications, the Director may constitute a Screening 
Committee, which will short-list the candidates. 


In case of direct recruitment, the selection shall be transparent by giving specific marks for various 
parameters decided by the Selection Committee, keeping in view the job requirement for the post. The 
Selection Committee as constituted by competent authority will hold interviews of the all-eligible candidates, 
as may be required. 


Vacancies caused by the incumbent being away on deputation or long illness or study leave or under other 
circumstances, for duration of one year or more, can be filled on deputation/short term contract.

लघु शीर्षक एवं प्रवर्तन :- 

इन विनियमों को ग्रुप ‘at गैर संकाय पद (कार्यालय अधीक्षक), रीजनल इंस्टीट्यूट ऑफ पैरामेडिकल एंड नर्सिंग साइंसेज, 
आइजोल, मिजोरम, 2023 के भर्ती नियम कहा जाएगा। 

यह विनियम राजपत्र में अधिसूचित किए जाने की तिथि से लागू होंगे। 

पे-मैट्रिक्स में पदों की संख्या, वर्गीकरण और स्तर:- 


पदों की संख्या, उसका वर्गीकरण और उससे जुड़े पे-मैट्रिक्स में स्तर अनुसूची | में निहित संबंधित पदों में निर्दिष्ट होगा। ग्रुप 
“बी” के रूप में पदों का वर्गीकरण केंद्र सरकार के वेतन स्तर में समान श्रेणियों के अनुरूप होगा। 

भर्ती मानदंड:- 

सभी पदों के लिए न्यूनतम शैक्षणिक योग्यता अनुसूची । में निर्दिष्ट के अनुसार होगी। संबंधित पद के लिए आवश्यक 
आरआईपीएएनएस के संबंध में गैर संकाय के हित के संबंधित क्षेत्रों में शैक्षिक योग्यता के लिए निर्दिष्ट अनुशासन, पदों के 
विज्ञापित होने से पहले अनुसूची | में दिया जाएगा। मान्यता प्राप्त विश्वविद्यालय और नियामक निकायों की शैक्षिक योग्यता, 
यथास्थिति, केवल स्वीकार किया जाएगा। शैक्षिक योग्यता के संबंध में किसी भी संदेह की स्थिति में, नियुक्ति प्राधिकारी का 
निर्णय अंतिम और बाध्यकारी होगा। 


सभी पदों के लिए आवश्यक अनुभव अनुसूची । में निर्दिष्ट अनुसार होगा। पद के लिए अपेक्षित अनुभव निर्धारित करने की 
निर्णायक तिथि अभ्यर्थी से आवेदन प्राप्त करने की अंतिम तिथि होगी। 


भर्ती अनुसूची | a निर्धारित अनुसार की जाएगी। जब भी पद सीधी भर्ती द्वारा भरा जाना हो, तो पदों का विज्ञापन 
आरआईपीएएनएस की वेबसाइट और समाचार पत्रों में ऐसे उचित तरीकों से किया जाएगा जो संस्थान प्राधिकरण उचित 
समझे। बड़ी संख्या में आवेदन प्राप्त होने की स्थिति में, निदेशक एक स्क्रीनिंग कमेटी का गठन कर सकते हैं, जो अभ्यर्थियों का 
चयन करेगी। 


सीधी भर्ती के मामले में, पद के लिए नौकरी की आवश्यकता को ध्यान में रखते हुए चयन समिति द्वारा तय किए गए विभिन्न 
मापदंडों के लिए विशिष्ट अंक देकर चयन पारदर्शी होगा। सक्षम प्राधिकारी द्वारा गठित चयन समिति सभी पात्र अभ्यर्थियों के 
साक्षात्कार, जैसा आवश्यक हो, आयोजित करेगी। 


पदधारी के प्रतिनियुक्ति या लंबी बीमारी या अध्ययन अवकाश या अन्य परिस्थितियों में एक वर्ष या उससे अधिक की अवधि 
के लिए दूर रहने के कारण होने वाली रिक्तियों को प्रतिनियुक्ति/अल्पकालिक अनुबंध पर भरा जा सकता है। 


सीधी भर्ती हेतु आयु सीमा:- 


प्रत्येक श्रेणी के पद में सीधी भर्ती के लिए अधिकतम आयु सीमा अनुसूची | में निर्दिष्ट के अनुसार होगी। अनुसूचित जाति, 
अनुसूचित जनजाति, अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग और अन्य विशेष श्रेणियों के व्यक्तियों आदि के संबंध में अधिकतम आयु सीमा में केंद्र 
सरकार द्वारा समय-समय पर जारी आदेशों के अनुसार छूट दी जाएगी। 


जब तक भर्ती नियमों में अन्यथा निर्दिष्ट न हो, केंद्र/राज्य सरकार और केंद्र और राज्य सरकारों के स्वायत्त संस्थानों में सेवारत 
कर्मियों के लिए आयु में 5 वर्ष की छूट की अनुमति होगी। 


आयु सीमा निर्धारित करने की निर्णायक तिथि अभ्यर्थियों से आवेदन प्राप्त करने की अंतिम तिथि होगी। 
भर्ती की विधि: 
उक्त पदों पर भर्ती की विधि, आयु सीमा, योग्यता और अन्य मामले उक्त अनुसूची के कॉलम 5 से ॥3 में निर्दिष्ट किए जाएंगे।

Short Title and commencement: - 


These rules may be called the Recruitment Rules of Group ‘B’ Non - Faculty Post (Office Superintendent), 
Regional Institute of Paramedical & Nursing Sciences, Aizawl, Mizoram, 2023. 


They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 
The number of posts, classification and level in the Pay Matrix: - 


The number of the said posts, their classification and the level in the Pay Matrix attached thereto shall be as 
specified in Schedule I. The classification of posts as Group ‘B’ will correspond to similar categories in the 
Pay Level of Central Government. 


Recruitment Norms: - 


The minimum educational qualification for all the posts shall be as specified in Schedule I. The specified 
discipline for educational qualification in related areas of interest of the faculty in respect of RIPANS, 
required for the post concerned, will be as given in Schedule I, before the posts are advertised. Educational 
qualifications of recognized University and regulating Statutory Bodies, as the case may be, will only be 
accepted. In case of any doubt regarding educational qualification, the decision of Appointing Authority will 
be final and binding. 


The experience required for all the posts shall as specified in Schedule I. The crucial date for determining the 
experience required for the post shall be the closing date for receipt of application from candidates. 


Recruitment shall be made by promotion/deputation/direct recruitment as the case may be, as prescribed in 
Schedule I. Whenever the posts are to be filled up by deputation/direct recruitment, the posts shall be 
advertised in the website of RIPANS and newspapers by such appropriate methods as the Institute authority 
deems fit. In case of receipt of large number of applications, the Director may constitute a Screening 
Committee, which will short-list the candidates. 


In case of direct recruitment, the selection shall be transparent by giving specific marks for various 
parameters decided by the Selection Committee, keeping in view the job requirement for the post. The 
Selection Committee as constituted by competent authority will hold interviews of the all-eligible candidates, 
as may be required. 


Vacancies caused by the incumbent being away on deputation or long illness or study leave or under other 
circumstances, for duration of one year or more, can be filled on deputation/short term contract. 


Age limit for direct recruitments: - 


The upper age limit for direct recruitment in each category of post shall be as specified in Schedule I. The 
upper age limit in respect of Schedule Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes and the other 
special categories of persons etc, shall be relaxable in accordance with the orders issued by the Central 
Government from time to time. 


Unless otherwise specified in the Recruitment Rules, age relaxation of 5 years will be allowed for personnel 
serving in Central/State Government and Autonomous Institutions of Central & State Governments. 


The crucial date for determining the age limit shall be the closing date for receipt of application from 
candidates. 


Method of Recruitment: 


The method of recruitment, age limit, qualifications and other matters relating to the said post shall be 
specified in column 5 to I3 of the said schedule. 


In case of direct recruitment, the selected candidates, from the date of assuming the duties will be on 
probation initially for a minimum period as specified in Schedule I. At the end of probation period, the 
candidate’s performance will be assessed by the Institute authority to decide if the candidate’s performance 
during the probation period has been satisfactory or otherwise. If his/her performance is found to be 
satisfactory, he/she will be confirmed for regular appointment on completion of probation.

7. Interpretation: - 
Where any doubt arises as to the interpretation of any of the provisions of these rules, the matter shall be 
referred to Appointing Authority whose decision shall be final. 

8. Power to relax: - 
Where the duly constituted Selection Committee of RIPANS is of the opinion that it is necessary or 
expedient to do so, it may for reasons to be recorded in writing, relax any of the provisions of these rules with 
respect to any class or category of posts mentioned in Schedule I. This will be subject to acceptance of the 
Appointing Authority. 

9. Saving: - 

Nothing in these rules shall affect reservations, relaxation of age limit and other concessions required to be 
provided to candidates belonging to the Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes, Ex- 
Servicemen and other special categories of persons in accordance with the orders issued by the Central 
Government from time to time in this regard. The posts filled earlier will not be affected by these 
Recruitment Rules, which are being notified now. The job descriptions pertaining to various posts would be 
issued separately by RIPANS as an Office Order.

लघु शीर्षक एवं प्रवर्तन :- 

इन विनियमों को ग्रुप 'सी' गैर संकाय पद अवर श्रेणी लिपिक (एलडीसी), रीजनल इंस्टीट्यूट ऑफ पैरामेडिकल एंड नर्सिंग 
साइंसेज, आइजोल, मिजोरम, 2023 के भर्ती नियम कहा जाएगा। 

यह विनियम राजपत्र में अधिसूचित किए जाने की तिथि से लागू होंगे। 

पे-मैट्रिक्स में पदों की संख्या, वर्गीकरण और स्तर:- 

पदों की संख्या, उसका वर्गीकरण और उससे जुड़े पे-मैट्रिक्स में स्तर अनुसूची | में निहित संबंधित पदों में निर्दिष्ट होगा। ग्रुप 
YP के रूप में पदों का वर्गीकरण केंद्र सरकार के वेतन स्तर में समान श्रेणियों के अनुरूप होगा। 

भर्ती मानदंड:- 

सभी पदों के लिए न्यूनतम शैक्षणिक योग्यता अनुसूची । में निर्दिष्ट के अनुसार होगी। संबंधित पद के लिए आवश्यक 
आरआईपीएएनएस के संबंध में गैर संकाय के हित के संबंधित क्षेत्रों में शैक्षिक योग्यता के लिए निर्दिष्ट अनुशासन, पदों के 
विज्ञापित होने से पहले अनुसूची | में दिया जाएगा। मान्यता प्राप्त विश्वविद्यालय और नियामक निकायों की शैक्षिक योग्यता, 


यथास्थिति, केवल स्वीकार किया जाएगा। शैक्षिक योग्यता के संबंध में किसी भी संदेह की स्थिति में, नियुक्ति प्राधिकारी का 
निर्णय अंतिम और बाध्यकारी होगा। 


सभी पदों के लिए आवश्यक अनुभव अनुसूची । में निर्दिष्ट अनुसार होगा। पद के लिए अपेक्षित अनुभव निर्धारित करने की 
निर्णायक तिथि अभ्यर्थी से आवेदन प्राप्त करने की अंतिम तिथि होगी। 


भर्ती अनुसूची । में निर्धारित अनुसार की जाएगी। जब भी पद सीधी भर्ती द्वारा भरा जाना हो, तो पदों का विज्ञापन 
आरआईपीएएनएस की वेबसाइट और समाचार पत्रों में ऐसे उचित तरीकों से किया जाएगा जो संस्थान प्राधिकरण उचित 
समझे। बड़ी संख्या में आवेदन प्राप्त होने की स्थिति में, निदेशक एक स्क्रीनिंग कमेटी का गठन कर सकते हैं, जो अभ्यर्थियों का 
चयन करेगी। 


सीधी भर्ती के मामले में, पद के लिए नौकरी की आवश्यकता को ध्यान में रखते हुए चयन समिति द्वारा तय किए गए विभिन्न 
मापदंडों के लिए विशिष्ट अंक देकर चयन पारदर्शी होगा। सक्षम प्राधिकारी द्वारा गठित चयन समिति सभी पात्र अभ्यर्थियों के 
साक्षात्कार, जैसा आवश्यक हो, आयोजित करेगी। 


पदधारी के प्रतिनियुक्ति या लंबी बीमारी या अध्ययन अवकाश या अन्य परिस्थितियों में एक वर्ष या उससे अधिक की अवधि 
के लिए दूर रहने के कारण होने वाली रिक्तियों को प्रतिनियुक्ति/अल्पकालिक अनुबंध पर भरा जा सकता है। 


सीधी भर्ती हेतु आयु सीमा:- 


प्रत्येक श्रेणी के पद में सीधी भर्ती के लिए अधिकतम आयु सीमा अनुसूची । में निर्दिष्ट के अनुसार होगी। अनुसूचित जाति, 
अनुसूचित जनजाति, अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग और अन्य विशेष श्रेणियों के व्यक्तियों आदि के संबंध में अधिकतम आयु सीमा में केंद्र 
सरकार द्वारा समय-समय पर जारी आदेशों के अनुसार छूट दी जाएगी। 


जब तक भर्ती नियमों में अन्यथा निर्दिष्ट न हो, केंद्र/राज्य सरकार और केंद्र और राज्य सरकारों के स्वायत्त संस्थानों में सेवारत 
कर्मियों के लिए आयु में 5 वर्ष की छूट की अनुमति होगी। 


आयु सीमा निर्धारित करने की निर्णायक तिथि अभ्यर्थियों से आवेदन प्राप्त करने की अंतिम तिथि होगी। 
भर्ती की विधि: 
उक्त पदों पर भर्ती की विधि, आयु सीमा, योग्यता और अन्य मामले उक्त अनुसूची के कॉलम 5 से 43 में निर्दिष्ट किए जाएंगे।

Short Title and commencement: - 


These rules may be called the Recruitment Rules of Group ‘C’ Non - Faculty Post (Lower Division Clerk), 
Regional Institute of Paramedical & Nursing Sciences, Aizawl, Mizoram, 2023. 


They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 
The number of posts, classification and level in the Pay Matrix: - 


The number of the said posts, their classification and the level in the Pay Matrix attached thereto shall be as 
specified in Schedule I. The classification of posts as Group ‘C’ will correspond to similar categories in the 
Pay Level of Central Government. 


Recruitment Norms: - 


The minimum educational qualification for all the posts shall be as specified in Schedule I. The specified 
discipline for educational qualification in related areas of interest of the faculty in respect of RIPANS, 
required for the post concerned, will be as given in Schedule I, before the posts are advertised. Educational 
qualifications of recognized University and regulating Statutory Bodies, as the case may be, will only be 
accepted. In case of any doubt regarding educational qualification, the decision of Appointing Authority will 
be final and binding. 


The experience required for all the posts shall as specified in Schedule I. The crucial date for determining the 
experience required for the post shall be the closing date for receipt of application from candidates. 


Recruitment shall be made by promotion/deputation/direct recruitment as the case may be, as prescribed in 
Schedule I. Whenever the posts are to be filled up by deputation/direct recruitment, the posts shall be 
advertised in the website of RIPANS and newspapers by such appropriate methods as the Institute authority 
deems fit. In case of receipt of large number of applications, the Director may constitute a Screening 
Committee, which will short-list the candidates. 


In case of direct recruitment, the selection shall be transparent by giving specific marks for various 
parameters decided by the Selection Committee, keeping in view the job requirement for the post. The 
Selection Committee as constituted by competent authority will hold interviews of the all-eligible candidates, 
as may be required. 


Vacancies caused by the incumbent being away on deputation or long illness or study leave or under other 
circumstances, for duration of one year or more, can be filled on deputation/short term contract.

Age limit for direct recruitments: - 


The upper age limit for direct recruitment in each category of post shall be as specified in Schedule I. The 
upper age limit in respect of Schedule Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes and the other 
special categories of persons etc, shall be relaxable in accordance with the orders issued by the Central 
Government from time to time. 


Unless otherwise specified in the Recruitment Rules, age relaxation of 5 years will be allowed for personnel 
serving in Central/State Government and Autonomous Institutions of Central & State Governments. 


The crucial date for determining the age limit shall be the closing date for receipt of application from 
candidates. 


Method of Recruitment: 


The method of recruitment, age limit, qualifications and other matters relating to the said post shall be 
specified in column 5 to I3 of the said schedule. 


In case of direct recruitment, the selected candidates, from the date of assuming the duties will be on 
probation initially for a minimum period as specified in Schedule I. At the end of probation period, the 
candidate’s performance will be assessed by the Institute authority to decide if the candidate’s performance 
during the probation period has been satisfactory or otherwise. If his/her performance is found to be 
satisfactory, he/she will be confirmed for regular appointment on completion of probation. 


Subject to the candidate having minimum qualification and experience as specified in Schedule I, candidates 
from other Central Government/State Government can be taken on deputation basis. The period of deputation 
shall be for a period of three years which may be extended by the Director up to five years in the exigencies 
of service taking the consent of the lending department. 


Disqualification: - 
No person: 
(a) Who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living, or 


(b) Who having a spouse living, has entered in or contracted a marriage with any other person, shall be 
eligible for appointment to any of the said posts; 


Provided that RIPANS may, if satisfied that such a marriage is permissible under the personal law applicable 
to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt any 
person from the operation of this rule. 


Interpretation: - 


Where any doubt arises as to the interpretation of any of the provisions of these rules, the matter shall be 
referred to Appointing Authority whose decision shall be final. 


Power to relax: - 


Where the duly constituted Selection Committee of RIPANS is of the opinion that it is necessary or 
expedient to do so, it may for reasons to be recorded in writing, relax any of the provisions of these rules with 
respect to any class or category of posts mentioned in Schedule I. This will be subject to acceptance of the 
Appointing Authority. 


Saving: - 


Nothing in these rules shall affect reservations, relaxation of age limit and other concessions required to be 
provided to candidates belonging to the Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes, Ex- 
Servicemen and other special categories of persons in accordance with the orders issued by the Central 
Government from time to time in this regard. The posts filled earlier will not be affected by these 
Recruitment Rules, which are being notified now. The job descriptions pertaining to various posts would be 
issued separately by RIPANS as an Office Order.

सं. केविप्रा-टीएच-14-21/5/2023-टीआरएम प्रभाग.--केंद्रीय विद्युत प्राधिकरण (कोयला आधारित तापीय 
उत्पादन इकाइयों का बहुमुखी संचालन) विनियम, 2023 को सीईए-टीएच-17-13/4/2022-टीईटीडी डिवीजन दिनांक 
30 जनवरी, 2023 के तहत केंद्रीय विद्युत प्राधिकरण द्वारा अधिसूचित किया गया था; 

और जबकि उक्त विनियमों के विनियम 5 के उप-विनियमन (2) में यह अपेक्षा की गई है कि कोयला आधारित 


ताप विद्युत उत्पादन इकाइयों के बहुमुखी प्रचालन का कार्यान्वयन प्राधिकरण द्वारा समय-समय पर विनिर्दिष्ट चरणबद्ध 
योजना के अनुसार होगा; 


और जबकि हितधारकों की टिप्पणियों को शामिल करने के बाद चरणबद्ध योजना को अंतिम रूप दिया गया है। 
प्राधिकरण द्वारा अनुमोदित अंतिम चरण योजना अनुलग्नक में दी गई है।

अनुलग्रक 
(चरणबद्ध योजना) 


1. उपियोगिताएं नीचे उल्लिखित चरणबद्ध योजना के विभिन्न चरणों के तहत निर्धारित अवधि के भीतर इकाइयों को 
पूरी तरह से संशोधित करेंगी। 


2. उपियोगिताओं को चरणबद्ध योजना में प्रत्येक इकाई के लिए उल्लिखित एक महीने की अधिकतम शटडाउन अवधि 
का लाभ उठाना होगा। 


3. जहां तक संभव हो, उपियोगिताओं को वार्षिक ओवर हॉल (एओएच) अवधि के साथ बहुमुखी प्रचालन के लिए 
उन्नयनरिट्रोफिट कार्यों की शट्डाउन अवधि से मेल खाना चाहिए। 


4.  उपियोगिता संबंधित क्षेत्रीय विद्युत समिति (आरपीसी) के समन्वय से बहुमुखी प्रचालन के लिए उन्नयनरेट्रोफिट 
कार्यों के लिए इकाइयों की शटडाउन अवधि की योजना बनाएंगी। 


5. चरणबद्ध योजना के तहत निम्नलिखित पांच चरणों की पहचान की गई है जिसमें एक प्रारम्भिक चरण भी शामिल है:
